1: #!/usr/bin/env python3
2: """Bounded executions of the repository's real frontend runner; retain every arm."""
3: from __future__ import annotations
4: import argparse
5: import hashlib
6: import json
7: import os
8: from pathlib import Path
9: import re
10: import signal
11: import subprocess
12: import time
13: 
14: ROOT = Path('/Users/krypto/GitHub/ollama-eko-chat-read-integrity')
15: UI = ROOT / 'app/ui/app'
16: EVIDENCE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
17: BASE = 'd559da25a4db89fa9369d8be4106100803e82a58'
18: FOCUS = ['src/components/StreamingMarkdownContent.integration.test.tsx',
19:          'src/utils/remarkCitationParser.test.ts']
20: EXPECTED = {
21:     'renders distinct upstream Markdown rather than fixed or empty output',
22:     'renders the input code through the loaded syntax highlighter',
23:     'uses the citation cursor to select the correct upstream page',
24:     'does not invent a link for a missing citation page',
25:     'does not turn model-provided images or raw HTML into embedded resources',
26:     'carries the exact range and surrounding text into the citation node',
27:     'preserves the distinct generic citation payload',
28:     'coalesces adjacent equal cursors without dropping a different cursor',
29:     'does not coalesce citations separated by ordinary text',
30:     'leaves code and malformed delimiters alone',
31:     'preserves an empty document without manufacturing a citation',
32: }
33: CASES = {'candidate', 'full', 'no-output', 'no-citations', 'wrong-page'}
34: 
35: 
36: def digest(path: Path) -> str:
37:     return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
38: 
39: 
40: def save(path: Path, value: object) -> None:
41:     with path.open('x', encoding='utf-8') as f:
42:         json.dump(value, f, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)
43:         f.write('\n')
44: 
45: 
46: def source_files() -> list[str]:
47:     output = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'ls-files', '-z', 'app/ui/app'], cwd=ROOT)
48:     return [s for s in output.decode().split('\0') if s]
49: 
50: 
51: def fingerprints() -> dict[str, str]:
52:     return {s: digest(ROOT / s) for s in source_files()}
53: 
54: 
55: def execute(argv: list[str], cwd: Path, target: Path, label: str,
56:             env: dict[str, str], bound: int) -> dict:
57:     started = time.monotonic()
58:     timed_out = False
59:     stdout = target / (label + '.stdout')
60:     stderr = target / (label + '.stderr')
61:     with stdout.open('xb') as out, stderr.open('xb') as err:
62:         proc = subprocess.Popen(argv, cwd=cwd, env=env, stdout=out, stderr=err,
63:                                 start_new_session=True)
64:         try:
65:             code = proc.wait(timeout=bound)
66:         except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
67:             timed_out = True
68:             os.killpg(proc.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
69:             try:
70:                 code = proc.wait(timeout=5)
71:             except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
72:                 os.killpg(proc.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
73:                 code = proc.wait()
74:     receipt = {'argv': argv, 'cwd': str(cwd), 'exit_code': code,
75:                'timed_out': timed_out, 'seconds': time.monotonic() - started,
76:                'stdout': str(stdout), 'stderr': str(stderr),
77:                'stdout_sha256': digest(stdout), 'stderr_sha256': digest(stderr)}
78:     save(target / (label + '.json'), receipt)
79:     return receipt
80: 
81: 
82: def apply_fault(path: Path, case: str) -> dict:
83:     old = path.read_text()
84:     changed = old
85:     edits: list[tuple[str, str]]
86:     if case == 'no-output':
87:         edits = [('{content}\n          </Streamdown>', '{""}\n          </Streamdown>')]
88:         expected = 'renders distinct upstream Markdown rather than fixed or empty output'
89:     elif case == 'no-citations':
90:         edits = [('import remarkCitationParser from "@/utils/remarkCitationParser";\n', ''),
91:                  ('        remarkCitationParser,\n', '')]
92:         expected = 'uses the citation cursor to select the correct upstream page'
93:     elif case == 'wrong-page':
94:         edits = [('pageStack[cursor]', 'pageStack[0]')]
95:         expected = 'uses the citation cursor to select the correct upstream page'
96:     else:
97:         raise ValueError('Unknown fault')
98:     for a, b in edits:
99:         if changed.count(a) != 1:
100:             raise RuntimeError('Fault anchor does not match exactly once')
101:         changed = changed.replace(a, b, 1)
102:     path.write_text(changed)
103:     return {'case': case, 'file': str(path), 'edits': edits,
104:             'before_sha256': hashlib.sha256(old.encode()).hexdigest(),
105:             'after_sha256': digest(path), 'required_failure_title': expected}
106: 
107: 
108: def run(case: str, label: str) -> dict:
109:     if case not in CASES or not re.fullmatch(r'[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,70}', label):
110:         raise ValueError('Invalid case or label')
111:     target = EVIDENCE / 'runs' / label
112:     target.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
113:     head = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], cwd=ROOT, text=True).strip()
114:     before = fingerprints()
115:     save(target / 'source-before.json', before)
116:     cwd = UI
117:     fault = None
118:     if case not in {'candidate', 'full'}:
119:         cwd = target / 'frontend'
120:         cwd.mkdir()
121:         for rel in source_files():
122:             p = ROOT / rel
123:             tail = p.relative_to(UI)
124:             if p.is_symlink() or '.env' in tail.name or p.suffix in {'.pem', '.key', '.crt'}:
125:                 raise RuntimeError('Unexpected sensitive/symlink source in copy scope')
126:             dest = cwd / tail
127:             dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
128:             dest.write_bytes(p.read_bytes())
129:         (cwd / 'node_modules').symlink_to(UI / 'node_modules', target_is_directory=True)
130:         fault = apply_fault(cwd / 'src/components/StreamingMarkdownContent.tsx', case)
131:         save(target / 'fault.json', fault)
132:     env = dict(os.environ)
133:     env.update(PATH='/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin', CI='true')
134:     invocation = {'case': case, 'head': head, 'baseline': BASE,
135:                   'controller_sha256': digest(Path(__file__)),
136:                   'environment_overrides': {'PATH': env['PATH'], 'CI': env['CI']},
137:                   'scope': 'Real Node SSR renderer, Shiki, remark; not browser styling, app launch or live services',
138:                   'fault': fault}
139:     save(target / 'invocation.json', invocation)
140:     # All arms must compile before a failed assertion can count as fault detection.
141:     compile_result = execute(['/opt/homebrew/bin/npm', 'exec', '--no', '--',
142:                               'tsc', '-b', '--force', '--pretty', 'false'], cwd, target,
143:                              'typecheck', env, 150)
144:     args = ['/opt/homebrew/bin/npm', 'test', '--', '--run']
145:     if case != 'full':
146:         args.extend(FOCUS)
147:     args += ['--reporter=json']
148:     test_result = execute(args, cwd, target, 'tests', env, 240)
149:     raw = Path(test_result['stdout']).read_text()
150:     try:
151:         report = json.loads(raw[raw.index('{'):])
152:     except (ValueError, json.JSONDecodeError):
153:         report = {}
154:     files = report.get('testResults', [])
155:     assertions = [a for f in files for a in f.get('assertionResults', [])]
156:     titles = {a.get('title') for a in assertions}
157:     count = 154 if case == 'full' else 11
158:     failures = [a for a in assertions if a.get('status') == 'failed']
159:     statuses = {k: sum(a.get('status') == k for a in assertions)
160:                 for k in ['passed', 'failed', 'pending', 'skipped', 'todo']}
161:     collected = (len(assertions) == count and report.get('numTotalTests') == count
162:                  and EXPECTED <= titles and all(f.get('assertionResults') for f in files))
163:     completed = all(a.get('status') in {'passed', 'failed'} for a in assertions)
164:     clean = (report.get('success') is True and not failures
165:              and all(f.get('status') == 'passed' for f in files)
166:              and test_result['exit_code'] == 0)
167:     detected = (fault is not None and test_result['exit_code'] == 1
168:                 and any(a.get('title') == fault['required_failure_title']
169:                         and a.get('failureMessages') for a in failures))
170:     unchanged = before == fingerprints()
171:     met = (collected and completed and unchanged and compile_result['exit_code'] == 0
172:            and not compile_result['timed_out'] and not test_result['timed_out']
173:            and (clean if fault is None else detected))
174:     result = {'case': case, 'head': head, 'expectation_met': met,
175:               'compile': compile_result, 'tests': test_result,
176:               'expected_count': count, 'collected_assertions': len(assertions),
177:               'required_titles_discovered': EXPECTED <= titles,
178:               'counts': statuses, 'complete': completed,
179:               'original_source_unchanged': unchanged,
180:               'clean_tests_passed': clean, 'intended_fault_detected': detected,
181:               'failing_assertions': [{'title': a.get('title'), 'messages': a.get('failureMessages')}
182:                                      for a in failures],
183:               'file_load_errors': [{'name': f.get('name'), 'message': f.get('message')}
184:                                    for f in files if not f.get('assertionResults')],
185:               'result_path': str(target / 'result.json')}
186:     save(target / 'result.json', result)
187:     return result
188: 
189: 
190: if __name__ == '__main__':
191:     parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
192:     parser.add_argument('--case', choices=sorted(CASES), required=True)
193:     parser.add_argument('--label', required=True)
194:     args = parser.parse_args()
195:     result = run(args.case, args.label)
196:     print(json.dumps(result, indent=2))
197:     raise SystemExit(0 if result['expectation_met'] else 1)
